            disablewhen "{ xn__shadowdistance_control_wcb == block } { xn__shadowdistance_control_wcb == animationblock } { xn__shadowdistance_control_wcb == none }"
            range   { 0 10 }
            parmtag { "usdapischema" "ShadowAPI" }
            parmtag { "usdvaluetype" "float" }
        }
    }

    parm {
